title: memory_link_resolution contract
description: Link an issue entry to its resolution entry. Derived from MemoryLinkResolutionRequest (dope_memory_main.py:796) and DopeMemoryMCPServer.memory_link_resolution (dope_memory_main.py:415).

issue_entry_id.description: Required. ID of the issue entry.

resolution_entry_id.description: Required. ID of the resolution entry.

400.description: Entry not found (either issue or resolution): returns {linked: false} with error
